subject.title: fix(feishu): retry transient message send failures

question: Should Feishu message create/reply operations retry the proposed transient transport and HTTP status set by default when every attempt reuses one Feishu UUID?
rationale: The implementation and live proof support the approach, but accepting retries for ambiguous sends is an intentional delivery-policy choice whose duplicate, latency, and request-volume tradeoffs require Feishu-area ownership.

options.title: Approve bounded UUID retries
options.body: Accept the proposed classifier and two-retry boundary after refreshing the branch and confirming exact-head Feishu tests.

options.title: Narrow the transient set
options.body: Limit retries to the field-observed failures and selected 5xx statuses until broader classifications have additional production evidence.

options.title: Keep current single-attempt behavior
options.body: Decline ambiguous-send retries and continue surfacing transient create/reply failures without automatic recovery.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded UUID retries
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed classifier and two-retry boundary after refreshing the branch and confirming exact-head Feishu tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is prior review and merge involvement on the same Feishu outbound message surface.
